limitations: Gate M counts are probe counts until the registry-wide run lands: M.1 63/60 training families, M.2 22/20 evaluation families, SP-8.0 60/60 named items (last registry-wide run f1 at 7a4137d: 54/21/54).

Seventeen families became prediction tasks (D-63 and its amendment): their objective is the interventional or end-of-episode response at held-out settings, scored 1 - MSE / variance of the truth; their public references are model-fitting procedures (refs_adapt), several of them assuming a model class (a logit demand curve, a drifting bump, a rival that follows your average price, a peaked dose law, a saturating hub, a saturating output link).

Several prediction references are weak on one seed of a seed set (ch_sign_reversal, ch_demand_shift, cxc_balancing_constraint, cxc_latched_reversal); they pass the two-of-three rule, the margin is small.
Program-execution families pay compute by measured CPU time (D-20 metering); admission values of pe_* families can vary with machine load.
The planning families of 8.4.1-8.4.3 and the routing/cascade network families (8.7.1, 8.7.4) remain static-tuning or weak-reference worlds; their redesigns were reverted.

Six more families became interventional-prediction tasks or were added as such in the second continuation (ch_tech_transition v3, eng_delayed_controller v2, dl_short_term_damage v2, dl_delayed_adoption, net_congestion_routes, plan_spoilage, plan_serial_stages): 24 of the 63 admitted training families are now prediction tasks scored by 1 - MSE / variance of the truth at held-out conditions; their scripted references assume the model class of the mechanism (D-64), so a reference score of 0.9-1.0 shows feasibility, not that a generic learner can do it. The four new families are compact primitive-graph compositions (one to three stocks); their item coverage is honest but thinner than the planning/program engines' worlds they complement.

The slot job 'H: rapid final 2' (tools/final_job.sh f2 in the H scratch directory) snapshots the COMMITTED tree at its start (git archive HEAD) into a small git repository, runs the registry-wide admission (2 processes), assembles the cache and runs the H gate tests and unit tests there; outputs land in <scratch>/w3b-rapid/out/f2-* and the unofficial evidence copies in out/f2-evidence.
